scope: Draft native cases, not an executable Runtime scenario. Expected observations come from the Story, not generated code output.

cases.input: A two-operation prompt declares only echo, with a current draft interface and top-level kind partial. Select an echo test with fixed input and result checks.
cases.expected: Uploaded interface has echo only and no top-level kind. Authored interface still says partial. No operation, input, expectation or coverage claim is added.

cases.input: Otherwise equal declarations use explicit full, or omit kind.
cases.expected: Full loses only its top-level kind in the upload copy. The absent-kind source and tar remain byte for byte unchanged. Authored declarations are unchanged.

cases.input: Place full or partial first, middle and last in compact and multiline JSON, including CRLF and an escaped root key spelling.
cases.expected: Each upload is valid JSON without the root kind; all retained tokens and outside-block bytes remain exact.

cases.input: An executable interface includes a resource kind port, a nested input field kind and descriptions/prose containing the literal kind partial.
cases.expected: Only the executable interface root member changes. Resource kinds, schema properties, descriptions and prose remain exact.

cases.input: A valid declaration uses exponent/decimal schema values, a large integer limit, escaped strings and non-ASCII prose.
cases.expected: Projection retains every non-kind numeric token and escape byte. It does not round or reserialize JSON or change the prose hash.

cases.input: Capture one selected test and preview it, then observe lint, Check and fresh Try source multipart bodies through injected transport ports.
cases.expected: Preview sizes match uploaded bytes. Every source archive and its SHA use the same projected content; no request contains the PDD root kind.

cases.input: The reached partial declaration contains shared schema references or is supplied by the existing preparation hook.
cases.expected: Projection uses the same safely expanded/replaced effective source and snapshot. It creates no alternate discovery or archive path.

cases.input: Change only the authored classification between partial and full, leaving the executable declarations equal.
cases.expected: Authored file/prompt hashes change and local readers retain the new classification. Upload projection cannot bypass existing raw-source cache or approval freshness checks.

cases.input: Read/retry a saved batch after the source no longer recaptures to its original archive hash.
cases.expected: Existing source-mismatch safeguards prevent dispatch or reuse. Saved hashes, IDs and completed/unknown outcomes are not rewritten.

cases.input: Select unknown kind, malformed/multiple interfaces, missing operations, invalid limits, stale declarations, native-only or a caller reaching native-only.
cases.expected: Existing validation or not-run outcomes and reasons remain. No source filtering approves, repairs or dispatches a refused/native-only selection.

cases.input: A partial declaration also contains an unrelated unknown root field.
cases.expected: The unknown field is not silently deleted; normal admission diagnostics remain possible. Removing kind is not a generic schema bypass.
